title: feat(app-shell,types,i18n,cli)!: retire cloud:onboarding-next and cloud:plan-status (objectui#12954)
body:
Fixes #12954
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Retires the two Cloud SDUI widgets `cloud:onboarding-next` and `cloud:plan-status`, everything that existed only for them, and the readers that named them. This follows the card's ruling: retire at once, with no deprecation alias and no staged window. The Cloud control plane stopped drawing both (objectstack-ai/cloud#3010 composes those pages from generic blocks), and objectui's product-neutral rule (ADR-0060) removes a product surface once its page has moved off it. `useEnvironmentEntitlements` stays, because the environment list and `cloud:workspace-timezone-notice` still read it.

Written by the dispatched `os-dev` agent of `domain:ui` seat 1, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_0188TsgPV8kQXfuRuKmkj2ks`.

## The consumer reading this rests on

| repository | ref | reading | read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| objectstack-ai/cloud | PR #3010, merged as `94704206` | replaced both widgets | the card body, filed from cloud's dev report |
| objectstack-ai/cloud | `main` | **not read**: this session cannot read cloud. This is the seat's landing gate, and ACCEPT waits for it. | none yet |
| objectstack-ai/hotcrm | `main` `3b05ae7` | 0 hits for the four type strings | the seat, card comment `6249167259` |
| objectstack-ai/objectstack | `main` `0b44840dfd` | CHANGELOG lines and one doc comment in `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts` that cites `CloudOnboardingNext.tsx` as an example. No registration and no console-pin use. | same |
| objectstack-ai/objectui | `main` `7f9cc37d` | every hit is listed in the reader table below | this PR |

## Each removal, against a published surface and its consumer reading

| removed | where it was published | consumers after this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `cloud:onboarding-next` and its twin `app-shell:cloud:onboarding-next` (registry keys) | `@object-ui/app-shell` registers it at load, through a side-effect import in the entry | none: cloud replaced it, and hotcrm and objectstack read 0 |
| `cloud:plan-status` (registry key) | same | none, same reading |
| `CloudPlanStatusSchema` (TypeScript interface) | the `@object-ui/types` entry, and a member of `AnySchema` | none in this tree (grep 0 outside the deleted files). hotcrm and objectstack read 0 for the type string. |
| `CloudPlanStatusSchema` (zod arm) | `@object-ui/types/zod`, and an arm of `AnyComponentSchema` | same. `objectui validate` now refuses a `cloud:plan-status` node at `type`, pinned by a new case in `registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` |
| locale keys `cloudOnboarding.*` (5) and `cloudPlanStatus.current` | all ten packs of `@object-ui/i18n` (`./locales/*` is in its `exports`) | none: the only reads were `t()` calls in the two deleted widgets |
| four `sideEffects` entries, `dist` and `src` for each widget module | the `@object-ui/app-shell` manifest | not applicable: the modules are gone |
| `navRunActionHref` | **not published**: a helper in `hooks/useNavRunAction.ts`, absent from the package entry, whose `exports` map has only `.` and `./styles.css` | its one caller was `CloudOnboardingNext`. Kept, it would have been dead code that this PR created. |

The dispatch said app-shell "drops two exports". Measured: the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry never exported `CloudOnboardingNext` or `CloudPlanStatus` by name. It imported their modules for their side effects, so what this package loses is three registry keys and four `sideEffects` entries, not named exports. The named-export removals are in `@object-ui/types`: `CloudPlanStatusSchema` from the entry and from `./zod`.

## What changed

- **Deleted.** `console/home/CloudOnboardingNext.tsx` and `CloudPlanStatus.tsx`, their two test files, and `packages/types/src/__tests__/cloud-plan-status-arm-10919.test.ts`. Outside the deleted files, the only reader of the arm test was a comment in `cloud.zod.ts`, which goes with the arm.
- **app-shell.** Removed the two side-effect imports in `src/index.ts` and the four `sideEffects` entries.
- **types.** Removed the interface from `cloud.ts`, the arm and its refusal string from `zod/cloud.zod.ts`, the export, import and union membership in `index.ts` and `zod/index.zod.ts`, and the README row (the heading now says "Cloud Widgets (1)").
- **i18n.** Removed the `cloudOnboarding` and `cloudPlanStatus` blocks from all ten packs: 6 leaf keys per pack.
- **cli.** Regenerated `known-schema-types.ts` with `node scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs`, not by hand. The generator dropped exactly three keys.
- **Allowlist.** In `product-specific.allowlist.json`, removed 3 registrations, 2 files and 2 i18n namespaces (6 leaf keys), 15 lines in all. The dispatch said "down by exactly two". Measured, the live list has to equal what the ratchet measures, and that is the number of entries above. ADR-0060's frozen baseline is the ceiling and stays as it is: it is a governed surface, and the ratchet accepts a live list smaller than the ceiling.
- **Pins that moved.** `NAMESPACED_REFUSED_AT_TYPE` went from 304 to 302. The two unarmed `onboarding-next` keys were refused at `type`. The armed `cloud:plan-status` left together with its arm, so it moved nothing. `EXPECTED_MIRROR_PAIRS` went from 206 to 205, one pair fewer.
- **Gate inputs.** `RULED_CONTROLS` in `check-sdui-registration-pins.mjs` keeps two of the three keys the 2026-08-29 ruling named, and the header says why. `check-side-effects-array.test.ts` no longer expects `CloudOnboardingNext.tsx` among the registrars. In `check-side-effects-array.mjs` and `vite-declared-lazy-views.ts`, the historical measurements keep the key and note that it has retired.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/12954-retire-cloud-onboarding-plan-status.md` declares `minor` for app-shell, types, i18n and cli, never `major`, per AGENTS.md's version policy. It lists FROM and TO for each retired name, the consumer reading and the fix.
- **Two pending changesets, prose only.** Their front matter is untouched. `11659-console-record-ux.md` described the `cloud:onboarding-next` button and `cloudOnboarding.openWorkspace` as live, and now says the same release retires them. `11930-workspace-timezone-notice.md` said the hook is the one that "the environment list and `cloud:plan-status` already use", and now names only the environment list. `pnpm check:changeset-claims` asks a change to correct a body that it falsifies.

## Verification

All runs used `--maxWorkers=2` or less. The head is `4f180c41`. Test set B ran at `d1167136`, and the only difference between the two is the two pending-changeset prose lines, which no file in the set reads.

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over `packages/types/`, `packages/i18n/`, `app-shell` `console/home/`, `environment/`, `hooks/`, `console/blocks/`, the ratchet, the runAction scan, the cli ratchet and the five gate-script suites: **585 files passed, 13,106 tests passed, 13 skipped**. Lock verdict `command-exit 0`.
- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...`: 28 of 28 tasks succeeded. Then `type-check` for types, i18n, cli and app-shell all exited 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` confirms the edited app-shell and types test files are in the compiled set.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` ✅, `pnpm changeset:check` ✅, and `pnpm check:changeset-claims` (report-only) ✅. Its self-contradiction reading covers 3 changesets.
- `pnpm check:side-effects-array` ✅. `pnpm check:sdui-registration-pins` needs a built console: see the line below.
- These also exit 0: `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:doc-types`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:unreferenced-sources` and `check:pending-changeset-literals`.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the 45-file list: NOT GOVERNED.
- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console` succeeded: 35 of 35 tasks. The `declared-lazy-views` plugin in that build, which is where the lazy-views check runs, printed "10/11 modules AppContent declares lazy are genuinely lazy; 1 eager, all pinned". After the build, `pnpm check:sdui-registration-pins` ✅: "All 18 registration(s) a `sideEffects` array promises are present in the built console … the 2 ruled control(s) are in the derived set". Lock verdict `command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm check:readme-exports` ✅. It reads `types/src/zod/README.md`, and it ran after cli and plugin-ai were built.

**Ablation (it re-adds a removed key family).** At `4f180c41`, `ablation-replace.mjs` put `cloudPlanStatus: { current: 'Current plan' }` back into `en.ts`. The anchor went 1 to 0 and the blob changed. The run was red: `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts` failed "en: no key is added under a frozen namespace unless the live list carries it", and `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` failed for each of the nine other packs ("missing 1 key(s): `cloudPlanStatus.current`"). That is 2 files and 10 tests red. The tool then restored the file, with blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The rerun of the same two files: 77 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, release text, left as is here.** In `.changeset/11930-workspace-timezone-notice.md`, the English example ("The workspace timezone was set to …") no longer matches `en.ts` ("The environment timezone was set to …"). The copy changed in PR #12865 (objectui#12851), not here, and the example will publish verbatim. It is reported to the seat.
- Update in `dc7e75a4`, on the seat's instruction: the 11930 example above now matches `en.ts` `cloudWorkspaceTimezoneNotice.seeded`, rendered with `Asia/Shanghai`.
- **Out of scope, objectstack.** The doc comment in `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts` that cites `CloudOnboardingNext.tsx` becomes a stale citation once this lands. objectstack is not edited here. Its `sdui.manifest.json` is regenerated from objectui's registry at its next `.objectui-sha` bump.
- `objectui validate` refuses a stale `cloud:plan-status` node with the union's generic `type` refusal, not a named tombstone. The ruling retires the type without a replacement spelling, and the objectui#12733 retirement precedent added no tombstone either.
